name: Ancient-Blooded Dwarf
text: You gain the Call on Ancient Blood reaction: when you attempt a saving throw against a magical effect, gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the save.

name: Death Warden Dwarf
text: When you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect with the void trait or one created by an undead creature, you get a critical success instead.

name: Forge Dwarf
text: You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme.

name: Rock Dwarf
text: Your feet are firmly planted. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to Reposition, Shove, or Trip you, and to saving throws against spells or effects that would force you to move or knock you prone. If any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you are moved only half the distance.

name: Strong-Blooded Dwarf
text: You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and each successful save against a poison reduces its stage by 2 (1 for a virulent poison); critical successes reduce it by 3 (2 for virulent).

name: Ancient Elf
text: In your long life you have dabbled in many paths. Choose a class other than your own; you gain that class's multiclass dedication feat, ignoring its level prerequisite.

name: Arctic Elf
text: You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme.

name: Seer Elf
text: You can cast the detect magic cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Identify Magic and to Decipher Writing of a magical nature.

name: Whisper Elf
text: Your ears are finely tuned. When you Seek, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to locate undetected creatures within 30 feet, and your flat check to target concealed or hidden creatures is easier when the condition is due to sound.

name: Woodland Elf
text: When Climbing trees, vines, and other foliage, you move at half your Speed on a success and full Speed on a critical success. You can always use the Take Cover action in forest terrain.

name: Charhide Goblin
text: You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Your flat check to remove persistent fire damage is DC 10 (DC 5 with appropriate assistance).

name: Irongut Goblin
text: You can subsist on garbage and can eat and drink while sickened. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against afflictions and the sickened condition from ingestion; successes on such Fortitude saves become critical successes.

name: Razortooth Goblin
text: Your jaws are a natural weapon: you gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the finesse and unarmed traits.

name: Snow Goblin
text: You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme.

name: Unbreakable Goblin
text: You're able to bounce back from injuries easily. Your maximum HP from your ancestry is 10 instead of 6. When you fall, reduce the falling damage as though you had fallen half the distance.

name: Skilled Human
text: You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in that skill.

name: Versatile Human
text: You gain a general feat of your choice (you must meet its prerequisites).
